title: Sandisk Stock: Buy, Sell, or Hold?
author: Marc Guberti
description: Sandisk stock has quintupled year-to-date and appears poised for further gains as Samsung's announcement of multiyear memory chip deals with Nvidia, Microsoft, and Alphabet through 2031 intensifies the memory shortage. Sandisk is growing faster than Samsung (372% vs 130% YoY revenue growth) and securing similar long-term contracts, providing revenue visibility and pricing power. With a 77% net profit margin and only a 20 P/E ratio, the company is well-positioned to capitalize on sustained AI-driven demand for memory chips.

title: Growth ETF Showdown: Vanguard Morningstar Growth ETF vs. iShares Small-Cap 600 Growth ETF
author: Sarah Sidlow
description: The article compares two growth-focused ETFs with divergent strategies: Vanguard Morningstar Growth ETF (VUG) concentrates on megacap tech leaders with an ultra-low 0.03% expense ratio and $372B in assets, while iShares S&P Small-Cap 600 Growth ETF (IJT) offers broader diversification across 377 small-cap stocks with a 0.18% expense ratio. IJT delivered stronger 1-year returns of 23% versus VUG's 16.2%, but VUG outperformed over 5 years with $1,802 growth on $1,000 invested compared to IJT's $1,343. The choice depends on investor risk tolerance and portfolio goals.
